text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide turns to me on the way
home one
day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you mind if we stop by that
cafe
again?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. There's something I want to tell
the
owner.
choice_data_list_en: We've got time, so sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I hope I'm not bothering you, but
I'd like to
talk to you about something.
Not as a customer,
but just in general.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: It's you again. Sure... What is it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The last time I was here, I wasn't able to

communicate my point very well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My failure to do so has been bothering
me ever
since, so I wanted to try
convincing you one more
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This time, I've prepared a presentation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
First, let me introduce some current data
to you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your clientele tends to skew slightly
older, and
customers usually come alone
or in pairs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Their main purpose of visiting is to read,
study, or
work. In general, they're lone
adults who are
looking to use their time
efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You should take advantage of this and
create a
space for your core clientele to
relax in!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are a few things you can do to
transform
this space into a hidden gem
of sorts and attract
an older crowd.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For example, you can dim the lights and
decorate
the space with wood paneling
and antique
furniture!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes my presentation!
What do
you think?

At the end of her talk, Biwa Hayahide is
as
breathless with excitement as she is
after finishing
a close race.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know what to say. I'm flattered
that
there's someone out there who
cares so much
about my shop.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: But why do you care so much?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The first reason is simply because I like
this cafe
and come here often.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The second is, well...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because I firmly believe that applied
logic can win
over raw talent.

Biwa Hayahide's eyes sparkle with firm
conviction.
Her words ring true to her
sincere approach to
life.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When you first told me about your
situation, I saw
myself in your story.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I also know what it's like to feel
overwhelmed by
seemingly unbeatable
competition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how strong an opponent
might be,
there's always a way to
triumph over the odds.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely believe that, and I want you
to believe
it too.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Wow. I...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think I'll give some more
thought to
the fate of this place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm glad I was able to present my
idea
before the cafe closed for good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm glad I was able to present my
idea
before the cafe closed for good.

choice_data_list_en: It was persuasive precisely because it was you.
It was so persuasive precisely because it came from you.
Your logic really speaks to me.
Your logic really speaks to the heart.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I suppose all the reasoning and
theorizing I
do on a daily basis came in
handy.

choice_data_list_en: It was persuasive precisely because it was you.
It was so persuasive precisely because it came from you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I hope I didn't come off as too high and
mighty,
though. After all, everything I've
learned was
through trial and error.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I understand how discouraging it can
be to
face such tough odds, and I don't
want the owner
to give up so easily.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I really hope I was able to communicate
that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You don't think I was being too
pushy, do
you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's hard for me to temper my feelings
when it
comes to things I'm passionate
about.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even plan on making a
presentation,
originally. It just sort of...
happened.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thank you.
choice_data_list: つい、で作れるのがすごい
choice_data_list_en: It's amazing you can make this on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I made it. I think it helped me
get my
point across more clearly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm... You really think so?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear my logic was able to
motivate
others.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm fairly confident in my analytical
abilities, so
let me know if you are ever
in need of them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can examine any issue of yours from
different
angles and analyze it for you.

Several days pass since Biwa Hayahide
and I last
went out together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's still open and operational, of course.
Look.
choice_data_list: そういえばあのカフェはどうなった？
そういえばあのカフェはどうなったの？
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, what happened to that café?
Come to think of it, whatever happened to that café?

text_block_list.text:
I peer into the window and see that it's
been
remodeled to feel more intimate.
There are
several customers inside
relaxing.

All of them are leisurely sipping coffee
or reading
books. It looks very cozy even
from the outside.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'm so glad.

The shop owner and Hayahide's hard work really paid off, didn't it...

text_block_list.text:
She looks so genuinely happy that I
can't help but
feel the same way.
